purpose: Phase-8A treatment-pressure model. Treatment pressure is the selective + adaptive pressure exerted by EFFECTIVE treatment exposure and validated biological effect (stress / apoptosis from Phase 6). It is combined from component pressures into a bounded net_treatment_pressure and an ordinal state. CRITICAL: a high applied dose with negligible delivery must NOT create high intracellular treatment pressure - pressure depends on effective exposure and observed biological effect, never on applied amount. Schematic normalized values only.

coefficient_policy.valid_range: each component pressure and net_treatment_pressure in [0,1]
coefficient_policy.1_interpretation: 1 = maximal schematic pressure the model represents
coefficient_policy.source: normalized modeling abstraction over validated upstream effective-exposure + stress + apoptosis outputs
coefficient_policy.sensitivity_note: combination_weights are schematic; net pressure is a weighted, bounded combination - not a measured selection coefficient.
coefficient_policy.limitations: No selection coefficient, kill rate, or growth-inhibition constant (all NOT_REPORTED).

rules.delivery_gated: net_treatment_pressure is gated by effective exposure; when effective exposure is negligible, pressure is negligible regardless of applied amount.
rules.selection_pressure_derived: selection_pressure is a downstream reading of net pressure x differential sensitivity, computed in the selection-pressure registry, not summed here.
